versions.content: { DRAFT } If function UdpNm_PnLearningRequest is called on a channel where UdpNmDynamicPncToChannelMappingEnabled is set to TRUE and UdpNm is in the Network Mode the UdpNm module shall set the Repeat Message Bit and the Partial Network Learning Bit in the CBV to 1 on this channel and change to or restart the Repeat Message State.
